items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1960-01-03
items.q: I was asked to play with Jack Lane... I'd take the job in his band, and I became the leader of that band up from around 1912 to 1916.

ctx.x: Susu Ramis, Harry Nunes, many bands. Then, around 1912, I was asked to play with Jack Lane.
Uh-huh. Oh, and this is the famous Papa Lane you used to call him.
That's right, old man Lane. He played ragtime drums, and he asked me if I'd take a job in his band.
